threshold_sources.T_gen_min_s: pairs with T_gen >= 1.0 s only (outputs long enough that generating them would take at least 1 s). 1.0 s sits just above the A1 auto_read p95 (0.938 s swechat CC, 0.977 s aiv_cc, 0.537 s cc_local), so smaller outputs cannot separate by construction.
threshold_sources.fp: ALIVE if fp_share <= 0.05 and its CI hi <= 0.10; WEAK if fp_share <= 0.20; DEAD otherwise
threshold_sources.auc: ALIVE if AUC >= 0.85 and CI lo >= 0.75; WEAK if AUC >= 0.70; DEAD otherwise; INSUFFICIENT_N if G is below min n
threshold_sources.flat: for a unit x tool_key with >= 30 qualified pairs from >= 5 sessions: FLAT if (p75 - p25 of delta_s) <= 2 x stamp resolution OR (p75 - p25 of log10 delta_s, positive deltas) < 0.05 (i.e. p75/p25 < 1.122).
threshold_sources.transfer: share of B qualified pairs with delta_s < the A-split p5 of the same unit x tool_key (cluster_rate). Nominal 0.05. The floor TRANSFERS if the CI overlaps [0.025, 0.10]; else the label is FLOOR_SHIFT (direction reported). Only for unit x tool_key with an A p5 (A n >= 100 from >= 5 sessions) and B n >= 100.
threshold_sources.step: p <= 0.01 AND D* >= log10(2) (a factor-2 shift of the floor) | floor STABLE if step share point <= 0.10, else UNSTABLE | series with n >= 2m, m = 20 (minimum segment size 20 pairs on each side)
threshold_sources.a1: KILLED if (a) no pair has both stamps (no timestamps), or (b) whole-second: more than 0.5 of the paired stamps (call and result ts pooled) are whole-second stamps, or (c) shared: more than 0.5 of pairs with both stamps have delta exactly 0 (identical stamp). Otherwise ALIVE.
threshold_sources.ci: for statistics lib/stats.py lacks (Spearman, AUC, w_adj, rate differences): resample sessions with replacement, n_boot draws from np.random.default_rng(seed), recompute the statistic on the concatenated draw, take the 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Draws where the statistic is undefined are skipped and counted; the CI is reported only if >= 900 of 1000 draws are valid.
threshold_sources.zero_count: when num == 0 the bootstrap CI is [0, 0]; report also the per-event Wilson upper bound and the per-session Wilson upper bound (resolution A2-3). Verdicts use the per-event Wilson upper bound in place of the bootstrap hi when num == 0.

verdict.DEAD: B fails the A1 kill rule; or every reportable W tool_key is FLAT; or fp label DEAD; or auc label DEAD
verdict.WEAK: anything else that is not DEAD (including fp ALIVE with auc INSUFFICIENT_N: no positive control)
verdict.downgrade: ALIVE becomes WEAK if the floor label is UNSTABLE or FLOOR_SHIFT holds for a majority of the unit's transfer-tested tool_keys
verdict.labels_added: aiv_cc: single-agent case study; units with < 30 B sessions: small n

deviations.prereg_said: pair: negative deltas kept in counts and excluded from log-scale statistics; silent on zero deltas for the linear quantiles, IQR, FLAT, floor transfer, step change and W
deviations.what_you_did: all per-tool statistics, FLAT, transfer, step change and the W set use qualified pairs with delta_s > 0, exactly as the A-split floors were computed (prereg_calibration.probe1_unit: Q = qualified & delta_s > 0); zero/negative counts are reported per tool (n_zero, n_negative), and the transfer share is also reported with them included
deviations.why: the transfer test compares B against the A p5, which excluded zeros; another population would not be like-for-like
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none found: non-positive qualified deltas = qualified_pairs - qualified_pairs_positive_delta per unit. A zero delta has r = 0 < 1, so including them could only lower fp_share

deviations.prereg_said: np.random.default_rng(SEED + i), i = 0-based index of the series in sorted (session_id, tool_key) order
deviations.what_you_did: i indexes the ELIGIBLE series (n >= 40) in sorted (session_id, tool_key) order
deviations.why: the text does not say whether ineligible series are counted; only eligible series are tested
deviations.effect_on_verdict: only steps with p above the minimum attainable 1/200 could flip under another convention; floor_step_change.sensitivity_steps_at_p_boundary gives the label without them

deviations.prereg_said: floor transfer only for unit x tool_key with an A p5 and B n >= 100
deviations.what_you_did: also required >= 5 B sessions (global.min_n.rate_reportable applies to every rate)

deviations.item: FLAT kill with no reportable W tool_key
deviations.prereg_said: the unit is DEAD if every reportable W tool_key is FLAT
deviations.what_you_did: the kill requires at least one reportable W tool_key (no vacuous truth)
deviations.why: with none reportable, W is also below the separability min n, which the rule maps to INSUFFICIENT_N
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none if every testable unit has >= 1 reportable W tool_key (flat_test.W_reportable)

deviations.why: the A-side G counts were built with that code; OpenCode child threads do not share the parent session_id
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none if the cross-check counts are 0 (see JSON)
